loss_budget_rules: Every Cauchy-Schwarz step must record its exact X and log X cost.
An estimate with loss comparable to log X does not close the original one-failure argument.
A dense-centre average requires a proved restriction theorem for the increasing primorial centres.
Absolute-value control before main-term subtraction loses the required signed cancellation.
A final theorem must resolve one failed centre on an absolute rather than merely relative scale.
